messages:
marie: heads up — planning social push for Redwood Optimize launch next Tue. need assets + final copy by Tue noon. plan: X thread, LinkedIn carousel, 15s clip, and 2 follow-ups. calendar invite in #marketing calendar.
ajay: timeline works for me. can design deliver hero + 3 cards by Tue morning?
emma: @marie @ajay — i can do hero + 3 cards, 15s clip is +2h. need benchmark numbers and quote to populate cards. also prefer 1x and 2x aspect ratios.
marie: attaching anchor numbers in thread: 40% latency reduction, 2.3x throughput for standard workloads, ~35% cost delta on p2 quantized runs. customer quote: "Cut inference cost by 35% without regression" — Acme Inc.
ajay: added UTMs we should use: utm_source=social&utm_medium=x_linkedin&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_content=thread_v1
emma: got it. can you paste the exact CTA url? will need shortened route for analytics.
tyler: rec posting windows: X thread -> 10:30am PT, LinkedIn carousel -> 1:00pm PT. schedule clip as pinned comment on X. also recommend pin profile for 24h.
marie: @tyler good call. who will actually post? ajay happy to post X thread and marie will post LinkedIn?
ajay: yep I can post X thread at 10:30. marie post LinkedIn at 1. i’ll DM creds and confirm.
marie: cool. engagement plan: first-hour monitoring by @tyler (replies + upvote seeding), first-day DMs by me, escalate inbound leads to #sales-inbox and tag @sales.
tyler: i’ll prepare canned replies and tracking sheet. do we want A/B headlines?
emma: suggest two headline options for test — keep both in the deck for copy variants.
marie: A/B ideas: 1) "Ship LLM features 3x faster" 2) "Cut inference cost without quality loss" — we’ll run 50/50 in X thread (first tweet alt)
ajay: for the thread structure: 5 tweets: hook, problem, what we built, benchmark bullets (use numbers), CTA + webinar link. keep each tweet <280 chars.
emma: card text request noted. will push assets to /drive/social/optimize_launch by Tue 10:50am. clip will be in exports/optimize_launch/clip_15s.mp4
marie: @emma please add a slide with clear CTA button text: "Demo the optimizer — sign up" and include small logo treatment.
emma: done. Also: do we want a LinkedIn alt text? I can write 1-sentence alt descriptions.
tyler: yes add alt for accessibility, and include captions for the clip. Also schedule 24h and 72h follow-ups with performance snapshot.
ajay: can ops create a short redirect for tracking? e.g., redwood.ai/optimize (redirect -> long tracking url)
community-bot: calendar event created: "Optimize launch — social ops" by marie — contains draft thread doc and checklist
marie: routing: inbound webinar signups -> CRM -> #sales-inbox; urgent demo requests ping @sales-oncall. EMMA please add CTA to capture company + role fields.
emma: will add CTA form fields on slide.
tyler: quick ops note: please ensure UTM on every outbound link. i’ll add validator to the scheduler.
ajay: ok i’ll queue the X thread in scheduler at 10:30 PT and post the LinkedIn manually at 1. will attach both copy variants so we can swap if engagement drops.
marie: thanks all — last ask: copy check and final sign-off by 9am Tue morning. emoji reactions to this thread = sign-off :rocket:
